{{Infobox/Item |image = Mana Flux Power Orb.png |type = [[Support item]] |rarity = rare |collection = Wolf Slayer 6 |museum = yes |museum_xp = 4 |museum_category = combat |id = MANA_FLUX_POWER_ORB |upgrades_from = Radiant Power Orb |upgrades_to = Overflux Power Orb |raw_materials = *163840 Gold Ingot *102400 Lapis Lazuli *4112 Wolf Tooth *1280 Emerald |mat_cost_bazaar = *16 Wolf Tooth *8 Enchanted Emerald *32 Golden Tooth *4 Enchanted Lapis Lazuli Block |raw_materials_upgr= *163840 Gold Ingot *102400 Lapis Lazuli *4096 Wolf Tooth |mat_cost_bazaar_upgr= *32 Golden Tooth *4 Enchanted Lapis Lazuli Block }} The '''Mana Flux Power Orb''' is a {{Rare}} [[Power Orbs|Power Orb]] unlocked in {{Coll|Wolf Slayer LVL 6}}. It is an upgraded form of the [[Radiant Power Orb]], and it can be upgraded into an [[Overflux Power Orb]]. == Obtaining == === Crafting === {{Crafting Recipe Table |{{Crafting Recipe Row |requirement = {{Coll|Wolf Slayer LVL 6}} |A1 = Enchanted Lapis Lazuli Block |B1 = Golden Tooth, 8 |C1 = Enchanted Lapis Lazuli Block |A2 = Golden Tooth, 8 |B2 = Radiant Power Orb |C2 = Golden Tooth, 8 |A3 = Enchanted Lapis Lazuli Block |B3 = Golden Tooth, 8 |C3 = Enchanted Lapis Lazuli Block |Output = Mana Flux Power Orb }} }} == Usage == {{ItemInfo |rarity = rare |type = Deployable |item_ability_name = Deploy |item_ability_activation = Right Click |item_ability_description = Place an orb for {{Green|1m}} buffing up to {{Cyan|5}} players within {{Green|18}} blocks.

When placed, it cannot be picked up; the ability spawns a new orb. === Crafting === {{Crafting Usage}} == Tips == *If the player is planning on doing a decent amount of Slayers or the Campfire Trials quest, this item is essential and should be obtained as soon as possible. == Trivia == *While [[Overflux Power Orb]], [[Overflux Capacitor]] and [[Plasmaflux Power Orb]] are all spelled as one word, this deployable splits '''Mana Flux''' into two words. == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2026/June 10|Changed the {{Blue|Mana Flux}} buff from healing {{Stat|Health|+2%}} per second to healing the spawning player {{Stat|Health|40}} per second, other players {{Stat|Health|20}} per second, and granting {{Stat|Health Regen|+50}} to both groups of players.|Added a {{Stat|Vitality}} cost of {{Dark Red|50}} to the ability.}} |beta= {{History|2019/October 11|[[File:Mana Flux Power Orb.png|26px]] Added '''Mana Flux Power Orb'''.}} {{History|2020/February 21|Added drop protection.}} {{History|0.26.1|Changed the {{Blue|Mana Flux}} buff from healing {{Stat|Health|+2%}} per second to healing the spawning player {{Stat|Health|40}} per second, other players {{Stat|Health|20}} per second, and granting {{Stat|Health Regen|+50}} to both groups of players.|Added a {{Stat|Vitality}} cost of {{Dark Red|50}} to the ability.}} {{History|2026/August 6|Extended the duration of '''Mana Flux Power Orb''' from 30 seconds -> 1 minute.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Slayer/Wolf}} [[Category:Support Items]] [[Category:Power Orbs]]
